What is the verified root cause?

The base cases for the first two houses are swapped, so the recurrence starts one house ahead and effectively treats the second house as unrobbable no matter what.

Adjacent houses are defined by shared walls in the floor plan rather than by consecutive indices in the list, so two houses that are numerically adjacent but not physically adjacent are allowed to both be robbed.
